The '''Refnar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Refnar]].
